newsitem.title: USA: Zila sees FDA speeding OraTest review.
newsitem.headline: Zila sees FDA speeding OraTest review.

text.p: Zila Inc Monday said it believes the U.S. Food and Drug Administration will speed its review of Zila's product, OraTest, following a recent meeting between company executives, cancer experts and FDA officials.
In clinical tests, OraTest has been nearly 100 percent sensitive for squamous cell carcinoma, which accounts for 95 percent of all oral cancer.
In a statement, Zila President Joseph Hines also called the meeting, which took place on July 2, "cordial and very productive."
A follow-up meeting has been set for early August.
